rationale: At revision 7b234db708fc1f07fa44d480fdaf6dba51bbcced, src/tmux.ts:216 must distinguish active Muse status from completed transcript prose, but an idle pane ending with "◆ Completed the review; use esc to interrupt a running turn" now returns muse-turn-chrome and sends nothing, indefinitely blocking the next ready-authorized handoff while that text remains visible; extend the existing prose-versus-chrome regression to Muse while preserving the measured narrow-pane busy cases.
